_comment: Seed data for the `companies` collection (Company Directory). Reproduces the 'seed script adds examples' feature from the design spec. Compiled from web search 2026-10-20, career URLs confirmed 2026-10-20. Every company listed here has a working discovery source in api/src/discovery/sources (confirmed against the live careers API/page). Companies without a usable source were removed: DataSoft (JS-rendered shell, no accessible job data), Kaz Software (site refused connections), TigerIT (no standalone careers page — posts to Indeed only), and REVE Systems (no structured job listings, only a generic resume-drop form).
